title: Independently qualify generated Math Discovery version metadata with ten bounded refusals
commitMessage: test: qualify Math Discovery version matrix and ten refusals

contribution.value: Add a standalone C# validator checking separated protocol/schema/library/generator/bundle versions, selected package identities and order, capability cardinality and runtime-only/no-broker boundaries. Reuse RS193 generator and prior qualifications without replay.
debtChanges: RS193 succeeded attempt 001 first-pass, generating skill-version.json from qualified manifest.
RS194 is a targeted metadata refusal gate, not new packages, public delivery, or an installed binary consumer.
M8-W01-C02 remains not-ready; no BrokerReady or AURA adoption is claimed.

RS194 pre-attempt refusal arose solely from ssh.github.com timeout during Git remote verification; durable preselection evidence 913407241ad17e34f899d2d9fd44efc0ba1f5a5b was later delivered, without allocating an attempt or mutating product files.
